verdict.rationale: Twenty documents auto-generated API documentation per workspace, covering both REST and GraphQL, plus an interactive playground. That points to a generated spec, but no evidence says the spec can be downloaded in OpenAPI or similar machine-readable form. The probe of common OpenAPI paths on the docs domain returned 404; since the docs site is not the workspace API host, this shows no public spec rather than contradicting any vendor claim. Missing for 10: an explicit downloadable OpenAPI/JSON spec or documented GraphQL schema export, a documented spec URL, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
